S01.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(market_value_usd),2) FROM harborline.pos_daily_position WHERE position_date_key=(SELECT MAX(position_date_key) FROM harborline.pos_daily_position)

S02.sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0*COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE settlement_status='FAILED')/COUNT(*),2) FROM harborline.stl_trade_instruction WHERE settlement_status IN ('SETTLED','FAILED')

S04.sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0*COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE reclaim_filed)/COUNT(*),2) FROM harborline.cae_income_payment WHERE reclaim_eligible

S05.sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0*COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE missed_deadline)/COUNT(*),2) FROM harborline.cae_client_election

S08.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(settlement_amount_usd),2) FROM harborline.stl_trade_instruction WHERE settlement_status='PENDING' OR (settlement_status='FAILED' AND actual_settle_date_key IS NULL)

M01.sql: SELECT cp.reliability_tier, ROUND(100.0*COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE i.settlement_status='FAILED')/COUNT(*),2) AS fail_rate_pct FROM harborline.stl_trade_instruction i JOIN harborline.dim_counterparty cp USING(counterparty_key) WHERE i.settlement_status IN ('SETTLED','FAILED') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

M02.sql: SELECT m.market_code, ROUND(SUM(p.penalty_amount_usd),2) FROM harborline.stl_fail_penalty p JOIN harborline.dim_market m USING(market_key) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

M03.sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0*COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE x.missed_deadline)/COUNT(*),2) AS missed_rate_pct FROM harborline.cae_client_election x JOIN harborline.cae_event e USING(event_key) GROUP BY CASE WHEN e.notice_window_days<=2 THEN 1 WHEN e.notice_window_days<=4 THEN 2 ELSE 3 END ORDER BY CASE WHEN e.notice_window_days<=2 THEN 1 WHEN e.notice_window_days<=4 THEN 2 ELSE 3 END

M04.sql: SELECT waiver_reason, ROUND(SUM(billable_amount_usd-invoiced_amount_usd),2) FROM harborline.clt_fee_invoice WHERE waiver_reason IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

M05.sql: SELECT m.market_code, ROUND(SUM(ip.reclaim_amount_usd),2) FROM harborline.cae_income_payment ip JOIN harborline.dim_market m USING(market_key) WHERE ip.reclaim_eligible AND NOT ip.reclaim_filed GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 5

M06.sql: SELECT c.client_segment, ROUND(SUM(p.market_value_usd),2) FROM harborline.pos_daily_position p JOIN harborline.dim_client c USING(client_key) WHERE p.position_date_key=(SELECT MAX(position_date_key) FROM harborline.pos_daily_position) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

M07.sql: SELECT s.security_type, ROUND(100.0*COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE i.settlement_status='FAILED')/COUNT(*),2) FROM harborline.stl_trade_instruction i JOIN harborline.dim_security s USING(security_key) WHERE i.settlement_status IN ('SETTLED','FAILED') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

M08.sql: SELECT c.client_name, COUNT(*) AS overdraft_days FROM harborline.pos_cash_balance b JOIN harborline.dim_client c USING(client_key) WHERE b.is_overdrawn GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 5

H01.sql: WITH ins AS (SELECT cp.reliability_tier t, COUNT(*) n, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE i.settlement_status='FAILED') f FROM harborline.stl_trade_instruction i JOIN harborline.dim_counterparty cp USING(counterparty_key) WHERE i.settlement_status IN ('SETTLED','FAILED') GROUP BY 1), pen AS (SELECT cp.reliability_tier t, SUM(p.penalty_amount_usd) a FROM harborline.stl_fail_penalty p JOIN harborline.dim_counterparty cp USING(counterparty_key) GROUP BY 1) SELECT ins.t, ROUND(100.0*ins.f/ins.n,2) AS fail_rate_pct, ROUND(pen.a,2) AS penalties_usd, ROUND(pen.a*1000.0/ins.n,0) AS penalties_per_1000 FROM ins JOIN pen USING(t) ORDER BY 1

H02.sql: WITH ev AS (SELECT e.market_key, ROUND(100.0*COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE e.notice_window_days<=2)/COUNT(*),2) AS short_notice_pct FROM harborline.cae_event e WHERE e.is_voluntary GROUP BY 1), el AS (SELECT e.market_key, ROUND(100.0*COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE x.missed_deadline)/COUNT(*),2) AS missed_pct FROM harborline.cae_client_election x JOIN harborline.cae_event e USING(event_key) GROUP BY 1) SELECT m.market_code, ev.short_notice_pct, el.missed_pct FROM ev JOIN el USING(market_key) JOIN harborline.dim_market m USING(market_key) ORDER BY ev.short_notice_pct DESC LIMIT 5

H03.sql: SELECT m.market_code, ROUND(SUM(ip.reclaim_amount_usd) FILTER (WHERE NOT ip.reclaim_filed),2) AS unfiled_usd, m.tax_reclaim_complexity, ROUND(100.0*COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ip.reclaim_filed)/COUNT(*),2) AS filed_rate_pct FROM harborline.cae_income_payment ip JOIN harborline.dim_market m USING(market_key) WHERE ip.reclaim_eligible GROUP BY m.market_code, m.tax_reclaim_complexity ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 5

H04.sql: WITH od AS (SELECT client_key, COUNT(*) AS overdraft_days FROM harborline.pos_cash_balance WHERE is_overdrawn GROUP BY 1), cd AS (SELECT i.client_key, ROUND(100.0*COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE cp.reliability_tier IN ('C','D'))/COUNT(*),2) AS cd_share_pct FROM harborline.stl_trade_instruction i JOIN harborline.dim_counterparty cp USING(counterparty_key) GROUP BY 1) SELECT c.client_name, od.overdraft_days, cd.cd_share_pct FROM od JOIN cd USING(client_key) JOIN harborline.dim_client c USING(client_key) ORDER BY od.overdraft_days DESC LIMIT 10

H05.sql: WITH ag AS (SELECT client_key, COUNT(*) AS aged_fails FROM harborline.stl_trade_instruction WHERE settlement_status='FAILED' AND days_failed>=5 GROUP BY 1), sc AS (SELECT client_key, SUM(billable_amount_usd-invoiced_amount_usd) AS sla_credits FROM harborline.clt_fee_invoice WHERE waiver_reason='SLA_CREDIT' GROUP BY 1) SELECT c.client_name, ag.aged_fails, c.sla_tier, ROUND(COALESCE(sc.sla_credits,0),2) AS sla_credits_usd FROM ag JOIN harborline.dim_client c USING(client_key) LEFT JOIN sc USING(client_key) ORDER BY ag.aged_fails DESC LIMIT 10

P01.sql: SELECT c.client_name, ROUND(100.0*COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE i.actual_settle_date_key=i.intended_settle_date_key)/COUNT(*),2) AS settlement_rate_pct FROM harborline.stl_trade_instruction i JOIN harborline.dim_client c USING(client_key) JOIN harborline.dim_date d ON d.date_key=i.intended_settle_date_key WHERE c.sla_tier='PLATINUM' AND d.year_num=2026 AND d.month_num=9 AND i.settlement_status IN ('SETTLED','FAILED') GROUP BY 1 HAVING 100.0*COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE i.actual_settle_date_key=i.intended_settle_date_key)/COUNT(*) < 99.0 ORDER BY 2

P02.sql: SELECT cp.counterparty_name, ROUND(100.0*COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE i.settlement_status='FAILED')/COUNT(*),2) AS fail_rate_pct, ROUND(AVG(i.days_failed) FILTER (WHERE i.settlement_status='FAILED'),2) AS avg_days_failed FROM harborline.stl_trade_instruction i JOIN harborline.dim_counterparty cp USING(counterparty_key) WHERE i.settlement_status IN ('SETTLED','FAILED') AND i.intended_settle_date_key>20251022 AND COALESCE(i.fail_reason_code,'')<>'MARKET_RESTRICTION' GROUP BY 1 HAVING 100.0*COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE i.settlement_status='FAILED')/COUNT(*)>10.0 AND AVG(i.days_failed) FILTER (WHERE i.settlement_status='FAILED')>4.0 ORDER BY 2 DESC

P03.sql: WITH openf AS (SELECT * FROM harborline.stl_trade_instruction WHERE settlement_status='FAILED' AND actual_settle_date_key IS NULL), expo AS (SELECT instruction_key, MAX(penalty_amount_usd) AS daily_penalty FROM harborline.stl_fail_penalty GROUP BY 1), od AS (SELECT DISTINCT client_key FROM harborline.pos_cash_balance WHERE is_overdrawn AND balance_date_key=(SELECT MAX(balance_date_key) FROM harborline.pos_cash_balance)) SELECT o.instruction_ref, CASE WHEN COALESCE(e.daily_penalty,0)>500 THEN 1 WHEN o.direction='RECEIVE' AND od.client_key IS NOT NULL THEN 2 WHEN c.sla_tier='PLATINUM' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END AS priority, ROUND(o.settlement_amount_usd,2) AS settlement_amount_usd FROM openf o JOIN harborline.dim_client c USING(client_key) LEFT JOIN expo e USING(instruction_key) LEFT JOIN od ON od.client_key=o.client_key ORDER BY 2, o.settlement_amount_usd DESC LIMIT 10

P04.sql: SELECT c.client_name, d.year_num, d.month_num, ROUND(SUM(p.penalty_amount_usd),2) AS penalties_usd FROM harborline.stl_fail_penalty p JOIN harborline.dim_client c USING(client_key) JOIN harborline.dim_date d ON d.date_key=p.penalty_date_key WHERE p.bearer='CLIENT' GROUP BY 1,2,3 HAVING SUM(p.penalty_amount_usd)>50000 ORDER BY 4 DESC

P05.sql: WITH rev AS (SELECT client_key, SUM(invoiced_amount_usd) inv, SUM(billable_amount_usd-invoiced_amount_usd) FILTER (WHERE waiver_reason='SLA_CREDIT') sla, SUM(invoiced_amount_usd) FILTER (WHERE fee_type='OVERDRAFT') odf FROM harborline.clt_fee_invoice GROUP BY 1), pen AS (SELECT client_key, SUM(penalty_amount_usd) p FROM harborline.stl_fail_penalty WHERE bearer='HARBORLINE' GROUP BY 1), fund AS (SELECT client_key, SUM(funding_cost_usd) f FROM harborline.pos_cash_balance GROUP BY 1), svc AS (SELECT client_key, SUM(analyst_hours)*85 s FROM harborline.clt_service_request GROUP BY 1) SELECT c.client_name, ROUND(rev.inv-COALESCE(pen.p,0)-GREATEST(COALESCE(fund.f,0)-COALESCE(rev.odf,0),0)-COALESCE(rev.sla,0)-COALESCE(svc.s,0),2) AS profitability_usd FROM harborline.dim_client c JOIN rev USING(client_key) LEFT JOIN pen USING(client_key) LEFT JOIN fund USING(client_key) LEFT JOIN svc USING(client_key) WHERE rev.inv-COALESCE(pen.p,0)-GREATEST(COALESCE(fund.f,0)-COALESCE(rev.odf,0),0)-COALESCE(rev.sla,0)-COALESCE(svc.s,0) < 0 ORDER BY 2
